summary: “Challenge, then, is to take minds and hearts formed over the long millennia of living in local troops and equip them with ideas and institutions that will allow us to live together as the global tribe we have become.” -Kwame Anthony Appiah #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
“Challenge, then, is to take minds and hearts formed over the long millennia of living in local troops and equip them with ideas and institutions that will allow us to live together as the global tribe we have become.”
-Kwame Anthony Appiah
#quote
